Based on the provided screenshot of the parking map UI:

1.  **ENTRANCE indicator:** **No.** There is no green "MASUK" or "ENTER" icon visible in this view. The map only displays the slot labels (A-01 to A-06 and B-01 to B-05) and a car icon on A-03.
2.  **EXIT indicator:** **No.** There is no red exit indicator visible in this view.
3.  **RAMP indicator:** **No.** There is no blue ramp indicator visible in this view.
4.  **LIFT and WC tiles:** **No.** Between row B slots (specifically between B-03 and B-04), there is only empty space/dashed lines representing the driving lane; there are no Lift or WC tiles present.

**Regarding the bottom floating navigation bar:**
The layout looks **properly laid out**. The yellow QR button ("Swipe to see all slots") is centered at the bottom and does not overlap or obscure any navigation labels. The compass icon ("N") is clearly visible in the bottom-left corner without any interference.

**Cut-off content:**
There does not appear to be any significant cut-off content within the main container, although the text below row B ("Cars enter top-right...") is slightly close to the bottom edge of the white card area. The large black space below suggests this is either the end of the scrollable content or there is more content further down that isn't shown in this specific crop.
